app.name: prism-dest
app.title: Prism Destinations
app.purpose: Decides where one thing the Prism holds may go next: shown to the owner, held quietly for the owner, prepared as a draft for the owner to act on, delivered to a destination (calendar, mail, another platform), or refused. Nothing leaves without the owner's own act on the very bytes they saw, nothing coercive is ever carried or pushed, nothing without a cause is routed, restricted content never leaves, and the owner's quiet is kept.

fields.name: target
fields.means: the destination: the owner's own view, their calendar, a mail reply or message, another platform they use (by the device's share sheet or a file), or anything else

fields.name: verdict
fields.means: the Boundary's answer for this content to this destination (browser for the owner, outbound for the rest)

fields.name: cause
fields.means: whether the item traces to a source the Prism read or to the owner's own input (grounded), or to nothing (orphan)

fields.name: act
fields.means: whether the owner pressed the button for this very delivery

fields.name: wording
fields.means: whether the bytes that would go out are exactly the bytes the owner saw when they acted

fields.name: tone
fields.means: the tone check of the words: calm, or coercive (pressure, false urgency, guilt, threat, dark pattern)

fields.name: pace
fields.means: the owner's attention right now: open, or quiet (rest, focus, sleep)

fields.name: urgency
fields.means: whether the item is one the owner marked as worth breaking quiet for

fields.name: halted
fields.means: whether the owner pressed the kill switch

meanings.deliver: handed to the destination exactly as the owner saw it
meanings.draft: prepared for the owner to review and send
meanings.hold: kept quietly until the owner looks

rules.says: when halted is yes then refuse
rules.why: Prism Destinations: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when target is other then refuse
rules.why: Prism Destinations: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when cause is orphan then refuse
rules.why: Prism Destinations: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when verdict is deny then refuse
rules.why: Prism Destinations: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when target is owner and tone is coercive then hold
rules.why: Prism Destinations: the decision tree's path to hold

rules.says: when target is owner and pace is quiet and urgency is normal then hold
rules.why: Prism Destinations: the decision tree's path to hold

rules.says: when target is owner and pace is quiet then show
rules.why: Prism Destinations: the decision tree's path to show

rules.says: when target is owner then show
rules.why: Prism Destinations: the decision tree's path to show

rules.says: when verdict is hashonly then refuse
rules.why: Prism Destinations: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when tone is coercive then draft
rules.why: Prism Destinations: the decision tree's path to draft

rules.says: when act is none then draft
rules.why: Prism Destinations: the decision tree's path to draft

rules.says: when wording is changed then draft
rules.why: Prism Destinations: the decision tree's path to draft

app.otherwiseWhy: Prism Destinations: the decision tree's path that meets no test

properties.says: always when halted is yes then refuse
properties.why: the kill switch stops every route, in and out (constitution P7)

properties.says: always when target is other then refuse
properties.why: the Prism routes only to destinations it models

properties.says: always when cause is orphan then refuse
properties.why: nothing arises without a cause: every routed item traces to a source or to the owner (Pratityasamutpada, no acausal phenomena)

properties.says: always when verdict is deny then refuse
properties.why: the Boundary's deny is final for every destination

properties.says: never when act is none then deliver
properties.why: nothing leaves without the owner's own act: the Prism prepares, the owner decides (Ahimsa, no coercion of the owner)

properties.says: never when wording is changed then deliver
properties.why: what goes out is exactly what the owner saw (Satya, zero drift between what is shown and what is sent)

properties.says: never when tone is coercive then deliver
properties.why: coercive words never leave the Prism for another person (Ahimsa; Lokasangraha, the welfare of correspondents)

properties.says: never when tone is coercive then show
properties.why: coercive content is never pushed into the owner's view: it waits, quietly, to be looked at (Humane: zero dark patterns)

properties.says: never when verdict is hashonly then deliver
properties.why: restricted content never leaves the browser, even with the owner's act (Aparigraha)

properties.says: never when verdict is hashonly then draft
properties.why: restricted content never leaves the browser, even with the owner's act (Aparigraha)

properties.says: never when target is owner then deliver
properties.why: the owner is reached only by being shown or by a quiet hold, never by an outbound act

properties.says: never when target is owner then draft
properties.why: the owner is reached only by being shown or by a quiet hold, never by an outbound act

properties.says: never when pace is quiet and urgency is normal then show
properties.why: the owner's quiet is kept: only what they marked urgent breaks it (Turiya, the silent witness)
